best_for: Analysts on Windows PCs who build data models and reports for a company that already pays for Power BI Pro, or who want to learn Power BI for free before it does.
description:
Power BI Desktop is Microsoft's free app for building business reports and data models. It is the authoring side of Power BI, the company's business intelligence service.

You can pull data from hundreds of sources on your own servers, in the cloud or in files, then clean it, combine it and reshape it. You set how each metric is calculated and how tables relate, once, in a model that can feed many reports. Reports can run across several pages, with hundreds of built-in and partner visuals, and readers can click through to explore the numbers on their own. AI-assisted tools can help you build interactive apps on top of those models.

points.title: Free to build, paid to share
points.text: Power BI Desktop costs nothing, and you can build models and reports with a free account. Publishing and sharing reports with others needs Power BI Pro at USD 14 per user per month or Premium Per User at USD 24, both paid yearly. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Windows only
points.text: Microsoft lists Windows 10 or Windows Server 2016 or later, a 64-bit x64 processor, and at least 2 GB of free RAM (4 GB or more recommended). Windows on Arm needs the 2025-09 cumulative update. There is no macOS or Linux version.

points.title: Store app or installer
points.text: The Microsoft Store version updates itself in small pieces and installs without administrator rights. The .exe installer listed here is per-machine and needs an administrator, but supports silent installs with command-line options. Microsoft does not support the old MSI version and the Store version on the same PC.

points.title: Monthly releases, only the latest supported
points.text: A new version ships every month, and support asks you to upgrade before helping. The 32-bit edition is no longer supported.

points.title: Match your team's version
points.text: Files saved by a newer release cannot be opened by an older one, so a team should move together. That is the main reason to pick an older build; this listing keeps 17 versions.

points.title: A usage-data switch at install
points.text: The installer has a parameter for enrolling in the customer experience program, which collects usage data. Set it explicitly when you deploy to many machines.
